kpis.nom_fr: Prévision d'investissements (CapEx) en part des ventes
kpis.citation: We expect capital expenditures for the full-year to be approximately 4% of sales as we continue to prioritize consumer-facing investments to fuel growth, including upgrades to our brick-and-mortar and online distribution channels, as well as targeted expanded consumer reach.
Of course, we started the year with a guide of 9.4%-9.9% on margin, and we significantly beat that through the year.

kpis.nom_fr: Trimestres consécutifs de gain de part de marché en Chine
kpis.nom_source: consecutive quarters of market share gain in China
kpis.citation: Now we are onto six consecutive quarters of market share gain in China.

kpis.nom_fr: Marques en croissance des ventes au détail en Chine
kpis.citation: In the last quarter, what is very impressive, we have 11 brands in retail sales growth, of which six are in double-digit growth.

kpis.nom_fr: Croissance de Le Labo en Chine
kpis.citation: Today, we have obviously continued to have very strong performance on La Mer, but we have a very diversified growth across now six brands in double-digit growth, and we have brands, Le Labo, that are growing in excess of 50% during the year.

kpis.nom_fr: Part de l'innovation mondiale issue de la Chine
kpis.citation: Now, 30% of our innovation around the world is coming from China for the China market, thanks to the ramp-up of all the activities we have from our R&D center in Shanghai.

kpis.nom_fr: Part du online dans l'activité en Chine
kpis.nom_source: online share of the business in China
kpis.citation: But obviously in online, which is now over 50% of the business in China, we are having great success with Douyin.

kpis.nom_fr: Marques présentes sur Douyin en Chine
kpis.nom_source: brands in China on the Douyin platform
kpis.citation: We have now 11 brands in China on the Douyin platform, and we are performing extremely well there.

kpis.nom_fr: Prévision d'expansion de la marge opérationnelle
kpis.citation: As we look forward on the guide that we have given 150 basis points to 230 basis points margin expansion, as we mentioned, that gross margin would be a modest driver, but a large part of the driver here will come, as you pointed out, from all of the SG&A, which includes employee cost and the announcement we made of the total restructuring that continues through 2027.

kpis.nom_fr: Relèvement du haut de fourchette de marge vs vue préliminaire
kpis.nom_source: top-end margin higher than preliminary view
kpis.citation: And this is also why, to reinforce the earlier question that was asked, why we felt comfortable to raise our preliminary view from a margin standpoint and even go beyond on the top-end at 13.5%, which is 50 basis point higher than our preliminary view that we have in the last quarter.

kpis.nom_source: organic sales growth in North America
kpis.citation: I was hoping, can you break down the 5% organic sales growth in North America in the quarter into how much of that was sell-through or consumption?

kpis.nom_fr: Accélération de croissance au point médian de la prévision
kpis.citation: If you look at the midpoint, there will be 100 basis point improvement.

kpis.nom_fr: Accélération de croissance au haut de fourchette de la prévision
kpis.citation: If you look at the top-end of the guidance, will be 200 basis point improvements.
